subject: Mythology
title: The Valkyries: Choosers of the Slain
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Valkyries: Choosers of the Slain.

hook.text: Valkyries rode through battlefields on flying horses, deciding which warriors deserved to live or die.

buildup.text: They were Odin's handmaidens, fierce and beautiful, carrying fallen heroes from the battlefield to Valhalla.

discovery.text: In some sagas, Valkyries fell in love with mortal heroes, defying Odin's commands to save them.

twist.text: The Valkyrie Brynhild disobeyed Odin and was cursed to sleep inside a ring of fire until a hero freed her.

climax.text: Sigurd rode through the flames and woke her, beginning a love story that ended in tragedy for both.

punchline.text: Even the choosers of death could not choose their own fate.

quiz.question: What was the primary role of the Valkyries?
options: Choosing which fallen warriors would go to Valhalla
Weaving the fates of gods and mortals
